description: This file defines a React context and hooks for authentication management using Supabase in a React application. It includes context creation, provider component, and custom hooks for authentication operations such as sign-in, sign-out, and role retrieval.

classes.name: AuthContextValue
classes.description: Type defining the shape of the authentication context, including session info, user info, loading state, and authentication methods.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component that provides authentication context to its children, managing session state and authentication actions.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access the authentication context, throws an error if used outside of AuthProvider.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Custom hook to retrieve the current user's role from session's user metadata.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias for useAuth, maintained for compatibility.
